llm.guidance: This skill is small and mostly coherent: it just instructs the agent to fetch weather and return a 1–2 sentence Chinese summary. Before installing, verify the network endpoint: SKILL.md contains a likely-typo 'out.in' but the example uses 'wttr.in'. If you intend the public wttr.in service, confirm or edit the instructions to use 'https://wttr.in/<City>?id=3'. Be aware the agent will make outbound HTTP requests that include the city name in the URL (no secrets are requested). If you want to be extra cautious, only enable the skill in an environment that restricts outbound network hosts or whitelist the intended weather service. If you cannot confirm the intended endpoint, treat the domain ambiguity as a risk and do not install.
